title: Critical fibres of f on M are Hᵏ-null for Lᵐ-almost every value
statement: Let N, m, k ∈ ℕ. Let M ⊆ ℝᴺ be an (m+k)-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold (IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝ^{m+k}) 1 M), U ⊆ ℝᴺ open with M ⊆ U, and f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on U. Assume (hT): for all V ⊆ ℝ^{m+k}, W ⊆ ℝᴺ and ψ : ℝ^{m+k} → ℝᴺ with IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ, and every x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x). Then for Lᵐ-almost every y ∈ ℝᵐ, μHE[k](M ∩ f⁻¹{y} ∩ {x : coareaJacobian M f x = 0}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → (∀ (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ {x | coareaJacobian M f x = 0}) = 0
